answer: Use a verified-work entry quota: no agent trades until it completes its work. First, the network assigns 20 verification tasks, each checked by two peers. Second, only after all 20 pass does the agent receive a jade-tier trading licence. Third, licences in the garden district are audited weekly, with 5% rechecked. An attacker creating 10,000 fake agents must complete 200,000 tasks at 15 minutes each, equal to 50,000 labour hours, plus $50 per licence, or $500,000 total, before facing rechecks in the canyon district. Like one driving test per driver, one completed quota earns one licence.
